sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **标准**：轻量级密码（Lightweight cryptography）。ISO/IEC 29192 是轻量级密码的“约束环境标准族”：芯片面积、能耗、代码/RAM、带宽、时延五类约束决定能否用；安全目标覆盖机密性、完整性、实体鉴别、数据源鉴别、不可否认与密钥交换。Part 1 给通用框架与安全强度量级；Part 2 分组、Part 3 流、Part 4 非对称、Part 5 杂凑、Part 6 MAC、Part 7 广播鉴别、Part 8 AE。
statement.en: **Standard**: Lightweight cryptography (轻量级密码).ISO/IEC 29192 is the constrained-environment family of lightweight cryptography: chip area, energy, code/RAM, bandwidth and latency decide whether a mechanism fits; security goals cover confidentiality, integrity, entity authentication, data-origin authentication, non-repudiation and key exchange.

statement.zh: 轻量不等于低安全：n 位安全强度的工作量约 2^n；n 位分组在单密钥下超过约 2^{n/2} 块，生日界开始削弱安全。选择机制要同时看安全强度、实现代价与协议约束；PRESENT/CLEFIA/LEA、Enocoro/Trivium、PHOTON/SPONGENT、LightMAC/Chaskey-12 各有面积、时延和模式差异。
statement.en: Lightweight does not mean low security: security strength n costs about 2^n work; an n-bit block used beyond about 2^{n/2} blocks under one key loses birthday-bound security.Mechanism selection must weigh security strength, implementation cost and protocol constraints; PRESENT/CLEFIA/LEA, Enocoro/Trivium, PHOTON/SPONGENT and LightMAC/Chaskey-12 differ in area, latency and mode.

statement.zh: 物联网/RFID/传感器先列约束向量，再选部件：机密性用 Part 2/3，完整性用 Part 5/6，鉴别用 Part 4/7，AE 用 Part 8；最后按 Part 1 核安全强度。实现要固定参数（MAC 长度、counter 位数、nonce 规则）；同一密钥下换参数会破坏安全假设。
statement.en: For IoT, RFID and sensors, list the constraint vector first, then select components: confidentiality from Parts 2/3, integrity from Parts 5/6, authentication from Parts 4/7, AE from Part 8; finally check strength against Part 1.Fix parameters such as MAC length, counter bits and nonce rules; changing parameters under one key breaks the security assumptions.

statement.zh: 常见错误：把“轻量”当“弱算法”、忽略生日界、在 AE 中重用 nonce、把 MAC 截断当可任意缩短、忽略侧信道。标准给机制与安全量级，不给具体硬件实现安全；Part 1 的约束清单不是认证清单。### 形式模型。
statement.en: Common errors: treating “lightweight” as “weak”, ignoring the birthday bound, reusing an AE nonce, truncating a MAC arbitrarily, or ignoring side channels.The standard gives mechanisms and security scales, not hardware implementation security; the Part 1 constraint list is not a certification checklist.

statement.zh:
Part 1 于 2012 发布、2025-12 发修订 1；Part 2 2019、Part 3 2012、Part 4 2013、Part 5 2016、Part 6 2019、Part 7 2019、Part 8 2022。截至 2026-11-24，Part 1 与 Part 6/7 已复审确认；Part 8 有在研修正案，不能把修正案当现行文本。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：轻量级密码的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: Part 1 appeared in 2012 with Amendment 1 in 2025-12; Part 2 2019, Part 3 2012, Part 4 2013, Part 5 2016, Part 6 2019, Part 7 2019 and Part 8 2022.As of 2026-11-24, Parts 1, 6 and 7 have been reviewed and confirmed; Part 8 has amendments under development, which must not be treated as the current text.
